title: DPF Install State
description: Persisted state at ~/.dpf/install-state.json. Read by every lifecycle script (install-dpf.sh, dpf-{start,stop,reinstall,release}.sh) so they don't redetect platform reality independently. Per the deployment doctrine (Contract 2: runtime configuration; Contract 3: lifecycle).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version for forward-migration. Lifecycle scripts must run dpf_state_migrate() if the file's schemaVersion is lower than the installer's expected version, or refuse to operate and direct the operator to re-run install-dpf.sh.

installerVersion.description: Installer version that wrote this file (semver-ish; e.g. '2026.05.10').

lastSuccessfulInstallVersion.description: Most recent installer version that completed successfully end-to-end.

lastSuccessfulComposeHash.description: sha256 of the rendered docker compose config from the last successful install. Used to detect compose drift on restart.

composeProjectName.description: Docker Compose project name. Defaults to 'dpf'.

platform.description: Host OS. win32 is informational only — the canonical Windows installer is install-dpf.ps1, which writes its own state.

arch.description: Host architecture. arm64 covers Apple Silicon and Linux ARM.

dockerContext.description: Active Docker context name (`docker context show`). null when DOCKER_HOST takes precedence or no context is configured.

dockerEndpoint.description: Resolved Docker daemon endpoint (unix socket path or DOCKER_HOST URL).

installPath.description: Absolute path to the repo root on the host. Mirrors DPF_HOST_INSTALL_PATH.

stateDir.description: Absolute path to the state directory (~/.dpf by default; XDG-aware on Linux when XDG_STATE_HOME is set).

composeFiles.description: Ordered list of compose -f files used at install time. The compose.sh helper assembles this dynamically; persisting it enables lifecycle scripts to use the same chain.

imageTag.description: DPF_IMAGE_TAG used at install time. null when running in dev mode (services build locally).

resourceLabels.description: Labels applied to all DPF-owned Docker resources for clean teardown. Default: { 'dpf': 'true' }.

autostart.description: Autostart configuration recorded at install time.

kind.description: Mechanism used: launchagent (macOS), systemd-user (Linux), scheduled-task (Windows; informational), none.

lastHealthCheck.description: ISO timestamp of the last successful /api/health check.

lastDoctorBundlePath.description: Absolute path to the most recent doctor bundle, for support reports.
